description: Source code implementing functions for writing and reading PKCS#8 private keys in PEM format, including encryption and decryption support, using OpenSSL library functions.

methods.name: PEM_write_bio_PKCS8PrivateKey_nid
methods.description: Writes a private key in PKCS#8 format with specified encryption algorithm to BIO.

methods.name: PEM_write_bio_PKCS8PrivateKey
methods.description: Writes a private key in PKCS#8 format, optionally encrypted, to BIO.

methods.name: i2d_PKCS8PrivateKey_bio
methods.description: Serializes a private key in PKCS#8 format to BIO.

methods.name: i2d_PKCS8PrivateKey_nid_bio
methods.description: Serializes a private key in PKCS#8 format with specific encryption algorithm to BIO.

methods.name: d2i_PKCS8PrivateKey_bio
methods.description: Deserializes a PKCS#8 private key from BIO.

methods.name: d2i_PKCS8PrivateKey_fp
methods.description: Deserializes a PKCS#8 private key from FILE pointer.

methods.name: PEM_write_PKCS8PrivateKey_nid
methods.description: Writes a private key in PKCS#8 format with specific encryption algorithm to FILE.

methods.name: PEM_write_PKCS8PrivateKey
methods.description: Writes a private key in PKCS#8 format, optionally encrypted, to FILE.
